stemMd: Two independent devices work with probabilities 0.8 and 0.9. What is the probability at least one works?
explanationMd: Use the complement: both fail with probability 0.2 times 0.1=0.02. Thus at least one works with probability 1−0.02=0.98.

distractorRationale.e: Adding probabilities ignores overlap and exceeds 1.
distractorRationale.a: This is the probability both fail.
distractorRationale.c: This is the probability both work.
distractorRationale.b: Independence gives both-failure probability 0.2 × 0.1 = 0.02; subtracting this from one gives 0.98, not 0.17.
